dict.string: ShantiSangha uses your microphone to record voice reflections — a way to speak what you feel when writing feels too heavy.
ShantiSangha transcribes what you speak into the assistant input so you can add reminders and ask questions by voice.
ShantiSangha reads your sleep, heart rate variability, and mindfulness minutes so your daily reflection can understand your whole day — not just the time you spend in the app.
ShantiSangha records your meditation check-ins as mindful minutes in the Apple Health app.
ShantiSangha uses your location to set your home base and read today's weather so your reflection can sense the sky you're living under.
ShantiSangha uses your camera when you choose to take a profile photo for friends to recognize you.
ShantiSangha needs access to your photo library so you can choose a profile photo and attach images to messages you send to friends.
ShantiSangha can save the people in your circle to your iPhone contacts so you can reach them outside the app.
